narrative: 人物看起来一动不动，而世界却变得不可信任。顿悟、恐惧或眩晕由此变成一个空间事件，而不只是一个反应特写。
只用一次；反复使用会让这种矛盾变成花招。如果只是普通的靠近，或者主体大小也在变化，那么这就不是合适的工具。
如果画面只是单纯放大，那是变焦。如果人物变大、房间随之滑动，那是推轨。
这个效果需要两者同时存在，且方向相反。
how: 排练推轨推进配合变焦拉远，或推轨后拉配合变焦推近。让主体在两端的尺寸保持匹配，并协调好对焦。
背景透视被拉伸或压缩，而被选定的主体则保持大小不变。提示词：希区柯克变焦——摄影机推轨移动的同时镜头做反向变焦，使人物大小保持不变，背景发生扭曲。
when: 用它来表现地面不再稳固的顿悟，且只用一次。具体场景：一个坐着的旁观者意识到海水已不再安全，身体大小保持不变，沙滩发生扭曲。
不要把它当作一种时髦的靠近方式来用。
vs: 推轨推进（Dolly In）会让主体大小和透视一起变化。慢速变焦推近（Slow Zoom In）则是在不移动的情况下改变大小。
希区柯克变焦保持大小不变、破坏透视关系。这种矛盾就是这个技巧的全部。
examples_film: 《迷魂记》（Vertigo）俯瞰钟楼楼梯井，空间随之弯曲变形。《大白鲨》（Jaws）在沙滩上保持布罗迪的大小不变，背景则发生扭曲。
《好家伙》（Goodfellas）在临近结尾的餐厅对话中，用这种拉伸的空间制造陷阱般的感觉。《恨》（La Haine）中有一个著名的天台变体。
要学的是几何关系，而不是照搬某张脸。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是慢速变焦推近，或者后期制造的背景扭曲。破绽在于主体大小发生了变化，或者画面拉伸却没有摄影机的实际移动。
解决办法：推轨与变焦方向相反，主体在两端的尺寸保持匹配，透视关系真实地发生变化。

faq.q: 电影中的希区柯克变焦（Dolly Zoom）是什么？
faq.a: 它是推轨与反向变焦同时进行的技巧，使主体大小大致保持不变，而周围的透视被拉伸或压缩。

faq.q: 希区柯克变焦（Dolly Zoom）与推轨推进（Dolly In）的区别
faq.a: 推轨推进是靠近后人物变大。希区柯克变焦则是在移动的同时做反向变焦，使人物大小不变，而世界在几何上变得不可信任。

faq.q: 什么时候该用希区柯克变焦（Dolly Zoom）？
faq.a: 当恐惧或顿悟应该发生在空间本身之中时使用。只用一次，不要把它当作默认的推进方式。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写希区柯克变焦（Dolly Zoom）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明：推轨推进的同时变焦拉远（或相反组合），主体大小保持不变，背景发生扭曲。禁止在没有摄影机实际移动的情况下用数码拉伸伪造效果。

narrative: The person appears fixed while the world becomes unreliable. Recognition, fear, or vertigo becomes a spatial event rather than merely a reaction close-up.
Use once; repeating it turns a contradiction into a trick. It is the wrong tool for a normal approach, and the wrong tool if subject size also changes.
If the crop simply grows, you zoomed. If the person grows and the room slides, you dollied.
how: Rehearse a dolly-in with zoom-out, or dolly-out with zoom-in. Match subject scale at both ends and coordinate focus.

Background perspective stretches or compresses while the chosen subject holds size. Prompt a dolly zoom: camera dollies while the lens counter-zooms so the figure stays the same size as the background warps.
when: Use it for a realization that the ground is not stable, and use it once. Concrete beat: a seated watcher understands the water is no longer safe, body size holds, beach warps.
Do not use it as a stylish walk-up.
vs: A Dolly In changes subject size and perspective together. A Slow Zoom In changes size without walking.
Dolly zoom holds size and breaks perspective. That opposition is the whole technique.
examples_film: Vertigo looks down the bell-tower stairwell as space flexes. Jaws holds Brody's size on the beach while the background warps.
Goodfellas uses the diner talk near the end as a trap in stretched space. La Haine has a well-known rooftop cousin.
Geometry, not a face to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Slow Zoom In or a background warp in post. The tell is a changing subject size, or a stretch with no camera travel.
The fix: opposite dolly and zoom, subject scale matched at both ends, perspective actually changing.

faq.q: What is Dolly Zoom in film?
faq.a: It is a simultaneous dolly and opposite zoom that keeps a subject roughly the same size while the surrounding perspective stretches or compresses.
Dolly in walks closer and the person grows. Dolly zoom walks and counter-zooms so the person holds while the world becomes geometrically untrustworthy.

faq.q: When should I use Dolly Zoom?
faq.a: When fear or recognition should happen in space itself. Use it once. Do not use it as a default push.

faq.q: How do I prompt Dolly Zoom for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write dolly in while zooming out (or the reverse), subject size constant, background warping. Ban a digital stretch without camera travel.
